createInvoice.a: Invoices page par jayein aur 'Add Invoice' par click karein ya fir Shift+N shortcut use karein. Client details fill karein aur save karein.

multipleStores.q: Kya main multiple stores manage kar sakta hoon?
multipleStores.a: Haan! Sidebar mein store switcher use karke aap ek hi account se multiple stores chala sakte hain.

voiceAI.q: Voice AI kaise kaam karta hai?
voiceAI.a: Customer ya Product pages par microphone icon click karein (ya Alt+V use karein). Details boliye aur AI apne aap form fill kar dega.

exportData.a: Zyadatar pages par 'Download' button ya Ctrl+D shortcut hai. Aap PDF ya CSV mein data export kar sakte hain.

ui.docsDesc: DragBizz Pro ke har feature ko use karne ke liye step-by-step guides.
ui.contactDesc: Direct help chahiye? Humari support team 24/7 chat aur email par available hai.
